~85% of ongoing project portfolio already sold; 18+ msf pipeline for launch over next 3 years.
FY26 customer handovers reached 3,465 units across 8 completed projects totaling ~4 msf.
Mrs. Revathy Iyer appointed as Independent Director; former RBI Central Board Member and Deputy CAG.
Dr. R. Seetharaman appointed as Independent Director; former CEO of Doha Bank (2007-2022).

timeline.summary: M. Murali, Shriram Properties Holdings Private Limited, and Shriram Group Executives Welfare Trust declared no encumbrance on their shares in FY 2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹640.88 Cr (+57.2% YoY), net profit ₹78.53 Cr (+64.8% YoY).
Shriram Properties released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation outlining strong financial recovery and FY27 guidance.
Shriram Properties uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 and FY26 earnings investor conference call held on May 25, 2026.
Shriram Properties hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 25, 2026, reporting record FY26 revenue of ₹1,357 Cr and issuing FY27 sales guidance of ₹3,300-3,500 Cr.
Aurum Real Estate Developers sold 1,00,000 shares of Shriram Properties, lowering its stake from 13.27% to 13.21%.
Appointed Mrs. Revathy Iyer (former RBI board member) and Dr. R. Seetharaman (former Doha Bank CEO) as Independent Directors for five-year terms.
